A new BxB visual novel from Gallium Games!

notes.title: New VN RELEASED: The Hepatica Spring!
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/c088f07223a2765ed7f7e14b9559c90e6fec6c1a.jpg

Our latest VN is now released!
The Hepatica Spring is a Nordic fairytale-inspired, fluffy fantasy story full of magic! It's a lighthearted romp with no bad endings--just relax and enjoy the adventure!
 Genre: Visual Novel, modern fantasy, comedy, (optional) romance
 Routes: 3 (romantic or friendship/platonic)
 Length: ~50,000 words
 Additional Features:
    - Name the main character
    - Play as any gender you please
    - Pet the best drog (dragon-dog) of all time: Digby!
Who will you dance with this Midsummer's eve? 💙

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1883990/The_Hepatica_Spring

notes.title: Achievement Bugfix (Again), Translation Update!
notes.content:
Achievements Fixed--Again!

After our update in December, there was a new different issue with achievements that arose. (They seem to hate us, for whatever reason.)

However, these should now be fixed! If you already completed the game and did not get them, please reinstall and delete your save/persistent files. Should you continue to not receive any achievements, please email us at contact@argentgames.co.

Translations

Thanks to the efforts of some amazing fans, we've got several translations available for YDD now, if you haven't seen them yet!

Current translations available are:
 French
 Russian
 Simplified Chinese
We are in talks to potentially be adding a Spanish translation in the future, so keep an eye out!

notes.title: New VN: Pale Cachexia!
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/6d9215144257e2544f27ded9d4e33a6c54c84ceb.jpg

Announcing AG's newest VN: A Gothic fantasy story called 
Pale Cachexia!

Demo Release: December 2020

Full Game Release: Q1 2021

https://store.steampowered.com/app/847680/Pale_Cachexia/?beta=1

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/e8eef48cdcb49e7854b9495e48ad995f84f4e2ab.png

In this Gothic story of deep bonds and chilling mystery, a young girl named Esther ventures deep within a forgotten forest.

There, she seeks out a potential cure for her mysterious illness: 
a life-leeching plague known as the Pale Cachexia.

But when Esther meets Seina, who lives all alone in a towering manor, the two girls are drawn to each other in a tale of friendship, sorrow, and bitter loneliness.

Their story is shadowed by the dark secrets of the manor and its cemetery, which haunts Esther even in her deepest dreams.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/b4e70a51233bcc9e96c4616ad054b5b3ce7f1d29.png
 Genres: Kinetic novel, Gothic fantasy, drama, horror
 Rating: PG-13 (language/mild horror)
 Endings: Linear
 Estimated Length: 60k-80k words
 Estimated Release: Q1 2021
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/7bbc2bd9ed1b21b637326db399f07db20a94d2fa.png

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/e8979e2c9c7a38f3e325545311a250a63e4f49c7.jpg

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/a6abfc23b80672d4ba320c6dc26ae1d65c0f0d2d.jpg

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/ec628676a54db68e1c3ab0998700006d1ae8636f.jpg

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/79c861672110ddc93a1cf7450f6b0925b08e7134.png

Other Info
 A short demo is planned for release this month
 The game is planned as a (relatively) short project to experiment with storytelling and new VN techniques
 As with all our Ren’Py games, it will release on Windows/Mac/Linux and Android

And that’s it for the big announcement! If you have any particular questions, join us on Discord or check out our weekly dev streams on Twitch every Saturday, starting at 7:30 AM PST/10:30 AM EST! We’re always happy to answer questions there, and now we’ll be working on some Pale Cachexia stuff openly as well.

Thanks so much for all of your amazing support, and stay safe out there!

notes.title: Self-Checkout Unlimited Now on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/1325d78c45c8941a3ac065ecb2430fe30c93f087.jpg

We just launched the Kickstarter for our latest game, Self-Checkout Unlimited! 

Check out the demo, available on both Windows and Mac!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/949b14fd40943965a2409be579ceba3378ceaed9.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/7485eb0a88a15812a07dfa222eaa95211bfc7488.png

An empty shopping mall after closing time.

Lost and alone inside a picture-perfect labyrinth.

As sunset slowly approaches, navigate between surreal stores to find the exit key, with only two cheerful PA announcers to keep you company. Can you unravel the mystery of your journey before it's time to say goodbye?

"Thank you for choosing Wilson Center Mall—a single stop for everything you'll ever need!"

❤

Inspired by the 8-circuit model of consciousness, the mallsoft genre, and the book Angel Tech by Antero Alli, Self-Checkout Unlimited is a unique exploration of both mind and matter.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/bbd4e38e21adfa56be771ef7175844dfe9bc22c5.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/cd767e7993b5b28d8a9df0472a79364ee7ef088b.png

Genre: Adventure, exploration, philosophical, surreal
Length: Short (~1-2 hrs, replayable)
Est. Release: Summer 2020

-Different story elements and endings based on your choices
-"Free Mall" mode—upon completion of the main game, explore the full mall freely without the story
-An original soundtrack inspired by nostalgic mall jazz and surreal dreamy synthscapes

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/b43323f5ad9a1b6680ba3ccfc53f865225b71bd1.jpg

You can find SCU's Steam page below, along with more details about our surreal new 3D adventure.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1221320/SelfCheckout_Unlimited/
